title: Crypto Trading Signals - July 31, 2026
top_story_headline: Umia launches public testnet for token auctions and decision-market governance
top_story_comment: Umia’s published Certora assessment logged 20 findings, including two high-severity settlement bugs; both were fixed and verified. Since a winning TWAP above the No-Op threshold becomes a MetaLeX Cayman SPC board resolution, governance security is priced by the capital required to hold a distortion across Umia’s default three-day market.
